sentences.en: The tensile strength of the rope is very high.
The fabric has good tensile properties, so it won't stretch easily.
sentences.zh: 这种布料有很好的可延展性，不容易伸长。

sentences.en: We need to calculate the tensile stress on the bridge supports.
sentences.zh: 我们需要计算桥墩上的拉应力。

senses.zh: 拉力的,张力的; 可伸展的；可拉长的
